reason: A dsh plugin that converts pasted image attachments into text through a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint so text-only models can process the image content.

summaries.zh: 将用户粘贴的图片发送到可配置的兼容 OpenAI 接口进行视觉识别，并把识别文字交给纯文本模型理解。
summaries.en: Sends pasted images to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint and provides the returned text to a text-only model.

capabilities: Reads pasted image attachments before model processing
Converts images to base64 data URLs
Sends image data to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision API
Replaces image blocks with returned text descriptions
Caches recognition results by attachment ID
Reads API credentials from configuration or environment variables
